{{Item infobox | description = Salvage Item | type = Trophy | material storage = Advanced Crafting Materials | rarity = Exotic | value = 256 | salvage = Standard | collection = A Legendary Path: Astral Gifts; Legendary Relics: Components; Legendary Weapon: Bolt; Legendary Weapon: Frenzy; Legendary Weapon: Frostfang; Legendary Weapon: Howler; Legendary Weapon: Incinerator; Legendary Weapon: Kamohoali'i Kotaki; Legendary Weapon: Klobjarne Geirr Gifts; Legendary Weapon: Kraitkin; Legendary Weapon: Kudzu; Legendary Weapon: Meteorlogicus; Legendary Weapon: Quip; Legendary Weapon: Rodgort; Legendary Weapon: Sunrise; Legendary Weapon: The Bifrost; Legendary Weapon: The Dreamer; Legendary Weapon: The Flameseeker Prophecies; Legendary Weapon: The Juggernaut; Legendary Weapon: The Minstrel; Legendary Weapon: The Moot; Legendary Weapon: The Predator; Legendary Weapon: Twilight | id = 19721 }} [[Glob of Ectoplasm]], abbreviated '''ecto''', is an [[Item#Rarity|exotic]] [[crafting material]] used in all high-level [[crafting]] excluding [[chef|cooking]]. It is also a [[token]] used for purchasing [[Ascended equipment|ascended]] [[accessory|accessories]] from a [[laurel merchant]]. They are acquired from salvaging [[Item#Rarity|rare]] or better equipment that is level 68 or above. Unlike most crafting materials, they cannot be [[Farm (term)|farm]]ed or purchased directly. This makes the Glob of Ectoplasm one of the most heavily traded items on the [[Trading Post]]. == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{Contained in}} === Salvaging === Generally, [[salvage|salvaging]] rare or exotic equipment ([[armor]], [[trinket]]s, and [[weapon]]s) with a required level of 68 or higher yields between 0 and 3 Globs of Ectoplasm. While there have been reports of a Glob of Ectoplasm being produced from items with a level below 68 or a lesser quality than rare, these exceptions are few and far between. See the [[Talk:Glob of Ectoplasm|talk page]] for further discussion. Extensive testing suggests that the drop rate is affected by three factors: * '''Level requirement:''' equipment rated at level 68 or higher have much higher yields than lower-level items. * '''Item rarity:''' rare and exotic items are much more likely to produce ecto than items of lower quality. * '''Kit quality:''' A controlled testMalgalad, [[User:Malgalad/Globs|Glob Salvage Tests]] reports that [[Master's Salvage Kit|Master's]] and [[Mystic Salvage Kit]]s yield about 0.90 ecto/rare, and [[Black Lion Salvage Kit]]s are anecdotally reported to give about 1.25 ecto/rare: {| {{STDT|mech1 align-center}} ! colspan="2" | Ectos produced per Rare item
with a Master's/Mystic Salvage Kit |- ! Quantity !! (1–5) And one of the following: * {{Salvages into|Fine Essence of Luck}} (5–15) * {{Salvages into|Masterwork Essence of Luck}} (1–3) * {{Salvages into|Rare Essence of Luck}} * {{Salvages into|Exotic Essence of Luck}} (1–4) Salvage research can be found [[Glob of Ectoplasm/salvage research|here]]. === [[Guild upgrade]]s === Guild upgrades which require Globs of Ectoplasm can be found [[Glob of
